text.title: Freelancer Rate Raise Letter Template Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from the contract clause to a written acknowledgement: pin the inputs, classify churn risk and cover concentration, set one number and the effective date, pull the value deltas, list in-flight work, write and tone-check the letter with the concession held back, schedule the T+7 follow-up, and apply the new rate only on written acknowledgement. Each step names the rule it satisfies and the fields of `02-output-contract.xml` it fills.

step.name: pin-the-inputs
step.input: The retainer contract (rate-change notice clause, billing cycle); the engagement log since the current rate was set; trailing-12-month revenue by client; the client's in-flight SOWs, quotes and prepaid periods.
step.action: Record each source in `inputs_used` with a stable path. Read `contract_notice_days` from the clause, the billing cycle from the invoicing history, and the date of the last rate change for this client (r-justify-with-value-delta-not-cpi, r-grace-period-at-least-30-days).
step.decision-gate: Contract clause or engagement log unreachable: do not draft; a letter without the clause is unenforceable and without the log is a CPI note.

step.name: classify-churn-risk-and-cover-concentration
step.input: Revenue by client; the client's realistic alternatives; most recent feedback or NPS; payment behaviour; renewal date.
step.action: Classify the client stay / negotiate / churn and write the evidence for each factor. Compute `revenue_share_pct_t12m`. If the class is churn and the share exceeds 30%, write the `replacement_revenue_plan` with named pipeline, expected close dates and monthly value before anything else happens (r-churn-risk-classified-before-send).
step.decision-gate: Churn above 30% of revenue with no plan: defer the raise; the letter is not drafted until the plan exists.

step.name: set-one-number-and-the-effective-date
step.input: Current rate; target rate; `contract_notice_days`; billing cycle; letter date.
step.action: State the new rate as one number with currency and unit, the current rate in the same unit and `change_pct`. Set `effective_date` at the longest of 30 days, one full billing cycle and the contract notice period after `letter_date`; record `days_to_effective` and `billing_cycles_to_effective`. If a raise already happened in the last 12 months, either document the material scope change or stop (r-single-new-rate-stated, r-grace-period-at-least-30-days).

step.name: pull-the-value-deltas
step.action: Extract at least one measurable delta delivered since the current rate was set: a named deliverable, a metric moved with before and after, scope or responsibility added, a capability the client now depends on. Each cites the `inputs_used` entry it comes from. Inflation or costs may appear as `cpi_or_costs_mentioned` but never as the sole justification (r-justify-with-value-delta-not-cpi).
step.decision-gate: No delta in the log: the raise has no case this quarter; stop and revisit at the next review.

step.name: list-in-flight-work
step.input: Signed SOWs, accepted quotes, prepaid retainer periods.
step.action: List every item in flight with its reference and kind, each marked as completing at the current rate; the new rate applies only to work agreed after the effective date (r-signed-work-honoured-at-old-rate).

step.name: write-the-letter-and-hold-the-concession
step.input: Steps 3-5; `templates/freelancer-rate-raise-letter-template.md.j2`; the banned-phrase list in r-business-notice-tone-no-apology.
step.action: Write under 250 words in the business-notice shape: open with the value delivered, state the change (one number, old and new, percentage), state what is protected, close with the effective date and the follow-up date. Scan for the banned phrases and any personal-cost narrative; strip every discount, alternative rate or "let me know if this is difficult". Record exactly one prepared concession in the artefact, for the follow-up only (r-business-notice-tone-no-apology, r-no-concession-in-the-letter).
step.decision-gate: Any banned phrase, more than 250 words, or a concession in the text: rewrite before sending.

step.name: schedule-the-t-plus-7-follow-up-and-send
step.action: Set `follow_up.date = letter_date + 7` and write one concrete path per response state: confirmed (send updated retainer terms for signature), no reply (short reminder restating the effective date), push-back (offer the single prepared concession or a scope call). Validate with `scripts/validate-freelancer-rate-raise-letter-template.py --file`, then send the letter (r-follow-up-at-t-plus-7-with-path).

step.name: record-acknowledgement-before-applying-the-rate
step.input: The client's written reply, or its absence, at the follow-up date.
step.action: Run the follow-up path for the observed state. Record `acknowledgement.received_in_writing`, `received_on` and `response_state`. Set `new_rate_applied = true` only after a written confirmation; silence never applies the rate (r-follow-up-at-t-plus-7-with-path).
step.output: `acknowledgement` complete; invoicing switched to the new rate from the effective date once acknowledged.
step.decision-gate: No written acknowledgement by the effective date: keep invoicing at the current rate and escalate to a call; do not invoice the new rate on silence.

list.item: One rate, one effective date at least 30 days, one billing cycle and the contract notice period out; at most one raise per 12 months unless a scope change is documented.
At least one value delta cited from `inputs_used`; in-flight work listed and protected.
Letter under 250 words, no banned phrases, no concession; one prepared concession held for T+7.
Churn class recorded with evidence; replacement plan present where the client is over 30% and classified churn.
New rate applied only after `acknowledgement.received_in_writing` is true.
